info.title: Website Image Audit REST API
info.description: Local loopback demo. Bearer credentials map to an owner; no OAuth issuance. All webpage-derived text is untrusted data. Request bodies reject unknown properties; query parameters are endpoint-specific. Responses use Cache-Control: no-store. Browser CORS permits localhost/127.0.0.1 on ports 5173/4173. OPTIONS preflight allows GET/POST and Authorization, Content-Type, Idempotency-Key; accepted preflight returns 204, rejected preflight 403. No accessibility-compliance claim.

get.description: Stream the complete published audit. format=json returns null if unavailable; format=csv returns a text notice. JSON includes full occurrences/candidates and separates image issues from coverage. CSV neutralizes spreadsheet formulas. A changed attempt or stream failure aborts the download; retry rather than using a partial file.

demoBearer.description: Provision with npm run auth:token -- <user>. Paste only into a trusted local client; do not persist or share tokens.

Cursor.description: Opaque forward cursor. Pass unchanged; it never grants ownership. Save request cursors to revisit pages.

Alt.description: Missing alt is distinct from intentionally empty decorative alt.

Image.description: One candidate row per occurrence, or a null candidate for an occurrence without sources. Resource is omitted for unresolved/skipped candidates. Occurrence candidates is empty in this projection; use the singular candidate field. Candidates are not proof of display.

Summary.description: issues counts image findings; coverageFindingCount counts coverage findings. The issues endpoint returns both scopes.

result.description: Official MCP CallToolResult; protocol-defined fields may be present. Tool errors can have isError=true while HTTP succeeds. See docs/MCP.md for structured tool data.
